source.note: Yield strength of a material in the zone a joining process affects, and how far the zone reaches. No numeric value was found for chromoly steel beside a weld or braze, so it has no row: the checks then use the parent strength and say so.

rows.source: Aluminum Association, Aluminum Structures FAQ (2020): welded 6061 tensile yield 15 ksi (Aluminum Design Manual Table A.4.3); about 1 in. either side of the weld is heat affected
rows.note: The 1 in. extent is the FAQ's description, not the Specification's clause.
